summary.text: Charley Thomson, a Republican, represents District 58 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Thomson as serving a second term and as an attorney.

paragraphs.text: The biography says Thomson graduated from Charles City Community High School in 1978, received an A.B. from the University of Michigan in 1983 and a J.D. from the University of Iowa College of Law in 1987.
It says Thomson was born in 1960 in Charles City and lives there.
